facts.business: Valplast Technologies Limited is a civil-engineering and construction company engaged in providing structural waterproofing systems, injection grouting solutions, pre-cast concrete systems, and MEP engineering services for various infrastructure projects including underground structures, tunnels, dams, channels, shafts, canals, reservoirs, buildings, and other civil engineering projects.

segments.name: Specialised waterproofing and allied infrastructure services
